preReview.title: Women's Super League predictions: Leaders Man City expected to bounce back against lowly Leicester
preReview.description: Manchester City's Women's Super League title charge was slowed down by Arsenal last weekend, but they now face strugglers Leicester City.

preReview.title: Pronósticos de la Women's Super League: el líder Man City, favorito para reaccionar ante el colista Leicester
preReview.description: El Manchester City vio frenada su pelea por el título de la Women's Super League el fin de semana pasado ante el Arsenal, pero ahora se mide al necesitado Leicester City.

preReview.title: Pronostici Women's Super League: la capolista Man City cerca il riscatto contro il fanalino di coda Leicester
preReview.description: La corsa al titolo del Manchester City in Women's Super League ha subito un rallentamento contro l'Arsenal nell'ultimo weekend, ma ora le Citizens affrontano un Leicester City in difficoltà.

preReview.title: Previsões da Women's Super League: líder Manchester City deve se recuperar contra o modesto Leicester
preReview.description: A campanha do Manchester City pelo título da Women's Super League foi interrompida pelo Arsenal no fim de semana passado, mas agora o time enfrenta o Leicester City, que briga na parte de baixo da tabela.

preReview.title: Pronostics WSL : leader, Manchester City attendu au rebond face à Leicester, mal classé
preReview.description: La course au titre de Manchester City en Women’s Super League a été freinée par Arsenal le week-end dernier, mais les Citizens doivent se relancer face à Leicester City, en difficulté.

preReview.title: Women's-Super-League-Prognosen: Spitzenreiter Man City soll sich gegen Kellerkind Leicester rehabilitieren
preReview.description: Arsenals Sieg bremste Manchester Citys Titelkurs in der Women's Super League am vergangenen Wochenende, doch nun wartet mit Leicester City ein Kellerkind.

preReview.title: توقعات الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز للسيدات: المتصدر مانشستر سيتي مرشح للعودة أمام ليستر المتعثر
preReview.description: توقفت مسيرة مانشستر سيتي نحو لقب الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز للسيدات أمام أرسنال الأسبوع الماضي، لكنه يواجه الآن ليستر سيتي المتعثر.

preReview.title: Previsões da Women's Super League: líder Man City deverá reagir diante do aflito Leicester
preReview.description: A corrida do Manchester City ao título da Women's Super League abrandou no último fim de semana frente ao Arsenal, mas agora segue-se o duelo com o aflito Leicester City.
